cumbati.p: [Cubi=cumba+a+ti] (kri) CL=10 Nīti, Dhā, 123] Sucks; keeps in the mouth (kisses).
a: စုမ္ဗတိ(ကြိ)
[စုဗိ=စုမ္ဗ+အ+တိ။

D: Cumbati，（cumb + a），吻。 【过】 cumbi。 【过分】 cumbita。 【现分】 cumbanta，cumbamāna。 【独】 cumbitvā。（p128）
B:
cumbati：cumbati（kri）
စုမ္ဗတိ（ကြိ）
[cubi=cumba+a+ti．nīti，dhā．123.]
[စုဗိ=စုမ္ဗ+အ+တိ။ နီတိ၊ ဓာ။ ၁၂၃။]
P: Cumbati，[Sk．cumbati．Dhtp 197 defines as “vadanasaṁyoge”] to kiss J.II，193； V，328； VI，291，344； VvA.260．Cp．pari°．（Page 270）
U: CUMBATI：（cumb +a） ôm hôn [aor] cumbi [pp] cumbita [prp] cumbanta，cumbamāna [abs] cumbitvā

[စုဗိ=စုမ္ဗ+အ+တိ။ နီတိ၊ ဓာ။ ၁၂၃။]
စုတ်၏၊ ငုံ၏ （နမ်း၏။ သျ）။
R:
cumbati：စုမ္ဗတိ （√စုမ္ဗ်）
နမ်း၏။ ပါးအစရှိသည်တို့ကို ပါးစပ်ဖြင့် စုပ်၏။
သီသေ စုမ္ဗိတွာ ဥယျောဇေသိ၊ ဦးခေါင်း၌ နမ်း၍ လွှတ်လိုက်၏။
DOP: cumbati pr. 3 sg. [ S. cumbati], kisses ; Dhātup 197 (cumba vadanasaṃyoge); Dhātum 285; Ja V 434, 1** (dārakaṃ … ~ati ~āpeti) = Dhp-a IV 197, 4 ; Sv 530, 25 (mātā ~issāmī ti onatā); Sadd 405, 21 foll. (cuba vadanasaṃyoge: puttaṃ muddhani ~ati, mukhe ~ati); — part.pr. cumbanta, mfn. , Ja II 193, 30´ (puttaṃ me disvā rājā tam eva ~anto parissajanto); Ud-a 88, 11 (bhagavato pāde sambāhanto ~anto, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se paricumbanto); — absol. cumbitvā, Ja V 328, 21 (puttaṃ Nandaṃ āliṅgitvā sīsaṃ ghāyitvā ~itvā); VI 291, 3* (te āgate muddhani Dhammapālo ~itvā putte avikampamāno); Vv-a 260, 26 (rājā puttaṃ āliṅgitvā sīse ~itvā); — caus. pr. 3 sg. cumbāpeti, Ja V 434, 1** = Dhp-a IV 197, 4 .

cumbaṭa.p: [Cubi=cumba+aṭa] (na) CL=10 A pad of cloth. (A) Pillow. (B) Footpad.

အခံ၊ အခု။ （က） ခေါင်းခု။ （ခ） ခြေခု။
R:
cumbaṭa：စုမ္ဗဋ （န）
ခေါင်းခု။
DOP: cumbaṭa n. [ cf Pkt cuṃbhala, and CDIAL 4869 ], a coil, a ring; a circular roll of cloth (used as a stand for a vessel, esp. when carried on the head) ; Vin III 140, 5 (obhatacumbaṭā nāma ~aṃ oropetvā vāseti; Sp 555, 31 : obhatacumbaṭā, kaṭṭhahārikādīnaṃ aññatarā, yassā sīsato ~aṃ oropetvā ghare vāseti, tassā etaṃ adhivacanaṃ); Ja V 413, 11 foll. (dāsīsu udakatthāya nadiṃ gantvā ~āni bhūmiyaṃ nikkhipitvā sukhakathāya nisinnāsu ekissā ~aṃ ekā sakasaññāya gaṇhi); Spk I 350, 22 (so pi ~aṃ āruyha kapālaṃ ādāya daṇḍaṃ olubbha); Mhv 41:95 (mahācetiyattaye ’kāsi sudhākammaṃ ca ~aṃ); — ifc see obhata-, dukūla-; — °- kalaha , m. , the quarrel about the head-coil (see Ja V 413, 11 foll.) ; Mp IV 132, 8 (~e, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se cumbaṭaka-); Th-a I 216, 15 (~-vūpasamatthaṃ satthari gate); — see also udakacumbaṭakalaha.
NCP: neuter a | cumba.ta coil, a ring; a circular roll of cloth (used as a stand for a vessel, esp. when carried on the head)

cumbaṭaka.p:
[Cumba+aṭa+ka] (na) CL=10 'ka' has no meaning.] See-Cumbuṭaka. (1) A pad of cloth; Pillow. (2) Circular frame made of cloth
 (3) Seat; Flower seat.
a: က-အနက်မရှိ။ စုမ္ဗုဋက-လည်းကြည့်။] (၁)အခံ၊ အခု၊ ခေါင်းခု။(၂)အခွေ၊ ကရွတ်ခွေ။(၃)ခုံ၊ ပန်းတင်ခုံ၊ ပန်းကလာပ်။

DOP: cumbaṭaka n. [cumbaṭa + ka 2 ], a coil, a ring; a circular roll of cloth (to support a vessel); a ring of flowers ; Abh 458 (aṇḍūpakaṃ ~aṃ); Ja III 87, 6 (kakkārūni nāma dibbapupphāni tehi katacumbaṭakaṃ pilandhitvā ussava-dassanaṃ agamiṃsu, Be, Ce so; Ee katacumbaṭaṃ; Se katacumbitakaṃ); V 292, 13 (nānāvidhaṃ mālāvikatiṃ ganthitvā … nānārūpavicitraṃ ekaṃ ~aṃ akāsi, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se cumbitakaṃ); Ps II 158, 29 (celaṇḍukenā ti ettha celaṃ vuccati vatthaṃ, aṇḍukaṃ ~aṃ, vatthacumbaṭakaṃ sīse katvā); Dhp-a I 139, 12 (cattāro āsīvise catūsu hatthapādesu ekaṃ gīvāya pilandhitvā ekaṃ sīse ~aṃ katvā ekaṃ ekaṃsaṃ karitvā); II 88, 18 (pañcahi sāṭakasatehi saddhiṃ ~āni katvā); Vv-a 33, 23 (pīthe atthataṃ sāṭakaṃ ~aṃ katvā); Thūp 208, 27 (rājā sannāhaṃ ~aṃ katvā pattaṃ vissajjesi); — ifc see dukūla-; — °- kalaha , m. , the quarrel about the head-coil (see Ja V 413, 11 foll.) ; Mp I 313, 8 (~e, Ce, Ee so; Be cumbāṭaka-; Se cumbiṭakulagehā).
